title: Freightliner Cascadia Road Train FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile aluminium Bullbar #16
description: Freightliner Cascadia Road Train FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile aluminium Bullbar, Custom contoured heavy duty main channel with provision for Active Brake Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control. Heavy duty box uprights with combination indicator and park light LED lights in main channel. High tensile 88mm diameter 6mm wall polished aluminium tube recessed welded into the box uprights, no but welds plus provision for driving lights. Custom built extra heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow 35mm tow pin. Dual light bar mounts and reversible Road Train signs on 5mm aluminium plate. Heavy duty mesh fitted for extra protection. All bars can be custom built to suit your requirements.
